summary: Insightin Health, a Baltimore-based healthcare technology company that provides an AI-driven digital health platform to health insurers, found suspicious network activity in September 2025. An attacker exploited a previously unknown vulnerability in a third-party application Insightin used and accessed or copied files on a limited number of servers between September 17 and 23, 2025, including health plan members' names, dates of birth, contract numbers, health insurance and Medicare Beneficiary Identifiers and attributed-provider information. The Medusa ransomware group claimed the attack, listed Insightin on its leak site and demanded $500,000 for 378 GB of data. Insightin notified 142,727 people; the Oregon Attorney General's site lists 1,144,686.
